subject: Error while trying to run parallel chains

messages.author: 81f2ee716ca4282f
messages.subject: Error while trying to run parallel chains
parts:
Hi,

Sorry to bother... I have a Windows, and I have been trying to run parallel chains by running the exact same code that I had previously tested, with the addition of options(mc.cores = parallel::detectCores()) at the beginning, which I thought to be sufficient after reading some older threads. 

The following error message appears:

Error in checkForRemoteErrors(val) : 
3 nodes produced errors; first error: unable to load shared object 'C:/Users/(...).dll':
  LoadLibrary failure:  "The process cannot use this file, since it is currently being used by another process". [I translated it since it was in portuguese]

Can you help me with this? Thks!

Ben

messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Re: Error while trying to run parallel chains
parts:
On Sunday, September 27, 2015 at 8:07:10 AM UTC-4, Vasco Conceição wrote:
Didn't get it, sorry.
When I run the code with cores=1, everything works fine.
Should I assume that this is a Windows problem and that I won't be able to run the chains in parallel?

Well, it is definitely a Windows problem. Are you an Administrator user on that Windows machine? In that case, Windows always asks me once whether I want to allow R to spawn additional processes. But maybe it doesn't even ask if you are not an Administrator user.

Ben
